backendText.finraDateInvalid: Missing, invalid or future FINRA date: the freshness of the stored figure cannot be verified.
backendText.lookupDateInvalid: Missing or future lookup date: the age of the stored figure cannot be verified.
backendText.noMapping: There is no reviewed mapping for this exchange or company.
backendText.sourceUnverifiable: The source returned no verifiable data; the previous figure keeps its date.
backendText.lookupWindowLimit: Lookup or trade date outside the 4-day limit.
backendText.noStoredLookup: No stored lookup. Use Refresh to query the public source.
backendText.dailyVolumeNote: Daily off-exchange short volume, not open positions or a share of the whole market. It does not imply bearish sentiment on its own.
backendText.cnmvScopeNote: Only public positions >=0.5%. The sum is not the market’s total short interest; dates differ by holder.
backendText.finraSettlementStale: FINRA settlement date older than 35 days; the daily volume keeps its own date.
